body:
I took a gummy. Never did anything but alcohol and DXM. It didn't work for about 30 minutes. I was watching youtube and suddenly everything was zooming out like on a screen. I felt like shaggy from scooby doo.
I laughed in the basement for about 5 minutes. Then I went upstairs before I was too high. My mom took the other half of the gummy and was already pretty zooted. She had smoked but never done edibles before. We laughed because we shouldn't have both done it at the same time. Then I started crying. My parents asked me if I was scared and I said yes. My dad brought my phone and headphones upstairs and I went to bed.
I scrolled youtube, laughed because I couldn't find any videos and just kept scrolling, then freaked out and tried to feel sober.
Then my heart started beating really fast and I was totally panicking. I thought I was dying, so I ran in my parents room and told them. My dad looked at the packaging and saw that it was **30 servings** so my mom and I went to the hospital.
My dad looked at the packaging and saw that it was **30 servings** so my mom and I went to the hospital.
Longest car ride of my life.
I kept telling my parents I was gonna die. My OCD was on hyperdrive. My dad said something about LSD and it kept bouncing around my head along with "Inappropriate", "Makes sense" and "doesn't make sense". I got to the hospital and chatted with my mom in the waiting room,  even though I should've been quiet.
Can't remember much at the hospital. The nurse or doctor assured me I can't die from Marijuana, I had an accident, embarrassingly. My dad and I chatted about star trek even though I hate it. I slept the next 3 days. Never again.
